resolvedStack: Next.js 14 + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS + Prisma + OpenAI + NextAuth
name: CortexOps AI Log Analyzer
description: CortexOps AI Log Analyzer is an observability and incident triage web SaaS that ingests service logs, flags production anomalies, and generates root-cause summaries via OpenAI v4 SDK with Prisma persistence.

metadata.name: CortexOps AI Log Analyzer
metadata.description: AI-powered log observability, anomaly alerts, and root-cause triage SaaS.

files.description: Next.js 14, React 18, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Prisma 5, NextAuth v4, openai, zod, lucide-react.
PostgreSQL Prisma schema with Role, Severity, IncidentStatus enums and User, LogStream, Incident, AiSummary models.
OpenAI v4 client singleton initialized with process.env.OPENAI_API_KEY.
Domain TypeScript types for LogStream, Incident, AiSummary.
Tailwind CSS directives and dark observability theme utilities.
Root layout with SessionProvider, Navbar, and Footer.
Landing page for CortexOps AI Log Analyzer.
Observability dashboard displaying active incidents, error rate KPIs, and AI triage summaries.
Incidents table with severity badges, filtering, and AI root-cause analysis trigger.
Client hook fetching /api/incidents with fallback mock array.
GET and POST API route for Incident records with Prisma and Zod.
POST API route calling OpenAI v4 client (with mock fallback when API key missing) to summarize log anomalies.
